card.name: Splitting a daily dose into parts
card.fires_on: The word "divided" (or the word right after it) in phrases about splitting a total daily dose into equal doses. Also number words and "times/-day" in regimen wording like "four equal doses" or "twice-a-day regimen".

modes.label: Equally divided doses
modes.description: "divided" or "doses" in the phrase "in equally divided doses" with a dosing interval.
modes.example: administered in equally<< divided>> doses every 4 to 6 hours

modes.label: Number of divided portions
modes.description: The count word after "divided into/in", such as four or six, before "equal doses".
modes.example: body weight divided in<< four>> equal doses.

modes.label: Daily regimen wording
modes.description: Parts of "twice-a-day" or "four times a day" regimen phrases.

card.writes: It seems to push toward words about parts or division, such as "division", "discrete" and "granularity".
card.plain: It fires where a dose is described as split into equal parts or given a set number of times per day.
